composition_not_a_closure: The five original caller certificates keep their 19 opaque owned contracts (unchanged by this replay). The composed Feed certificate is a separate artifact that discharges only NativeCodec.Extract, PublicMod and Wipe by inlining their certified bodies. In addition, this replay checks two adapter-helper roots (HkdfBridge.sequence, HkdfBridge.labelUnits) and nine NativeField owned-callee roots (seven private-arithmetic bodies with Q/ReduceOnce/Reduce inlined, plus the Q and MaxReduce public leaves) as separate certificates; those check new bodies only and do NOT discharge any contract of the five original callers. Two of the previously fifteen open roots are now checked, so thirteen open roots remain listed in open_roots, and every unchecked aggregate label (31, including "NativeMlKem.Field/NTT/codec/sampling helpers") remains explicit.
